formalRoundsScope.scope: Only the opening statements and first rebuttals are assessed. Introductory material and the entire subsequent audience-question portion, including both speakers' later replies, concessions, and concluding comments, are excluded. Moderator logistics within the approved window are not scored.
formalRoundsScope.requiredReaderDisclosure: Only the opening statements and first rebuttals (3:01–28:50) are assessed. The entire subsequent audience-question portion, including both speakers' later replies, concessions, and concluding comments, is excluded; neither speaker receives credit or penalties for that material. These scores are not an assessment of the complete recording.

instructions: Read every event of the complete approved formal-rounds source. The entire original recording outside this packet is forbidden; neither side receives credit or penalty for excluded material. Produce inventory only, no ratings, fallacy/bias judgments, totals, winner, or publication prose.

Create 4–7 coherent topical sections with unique lowercase semantic IDs, positive integer weightPercent summing to 100, and evidence-led weightRationale. Do not force symmetry. Select 8–48 substantive moves chronologically, each with a unique semantic moveId and exactly one section. A section must have at least one move per side and at most four per side; one to three is ordinary. Any fourth card must be distinct, independently assessable and non-mergeable with a frozen source-specific rationale of at least 40 characters. Structure coherent topics before judging; never compress scored moves later.

Each side needs 3–7 unique burden bridges: exactly one motion bridge and at least one central and subsidiary bridge. Use bridgeId, tier, burden, successCriterion. Assign each move to that side’s bridge, tier and reason. Importance is 1 supporting, 2 major, or 3 load-bearing, with source-grounded rationale; no score prediction.

Every move states claimSummary, reasonSummary and inferenceSummary {premise,inference,conclusion}. Use the smallest complete contiguous sourceSpan {startEvent,endEvent} proving the selected speaker’s claim and its load-bearing reason. Original eventIndex values are mandatory. The controller adds unchanged exact excerpt and timing. Target at most 2200 excerpt characters; a longer genuinely necessary span needs spanLengthRationale of at least 40 characters. Never pad spans for full-source coverage, cross a procedural transition, or include the opponent’s complete independent argument as the selected speaker’s own speech.

QuoteEligibleExactSpans must be 3–18-word exact substrings of the selected span; use the field name quoteEligibleExactSpans. Preserve captions without silent meaningful correction. AttributionConfidence and materialWordingConfidence are high, medium or low, each with a source-specific rationale. If meaningful caption wording or voice ownership is below high, attributionConfidence must also be below high to trigger audio. Do not evade a trigger by omitting a material argument.

A constructive move has respondsToIds:[] and responseComponents:[]. A reply points only to earlier selected move IDs with nonempty responseComponents, each {targetMoveId,component,description}. Explain the actual addressed component without creating an earlier-target link for a later utterance.

Compute both count audits exactly from moves; the controller independently recomputes them. selectionBalanceAudit thresholds {totalAbsoluteDifference:3,sectionAbsoluteDifference:2}, totals {pro,con,absoluteDifference}, sections [{sectionId,pro,con,absoluteDifference}], rationaleRequired boolean and rationale. Differences at either threshold need a source-specific rationale >=40 characters.

publicationCapacityAudit is {maximumSelectedMovesPerSidePerSection:4,sections:[{sectionId,pro,con,withinCapacity,fourthRowRequired,fourthRowAuthorized,rationale}],allSectionsWithinCapacity:true,allFourthRowsPreauthorized:true}. fourthRowRequired is true if either side has four; fourthRowAuthorized is true for a justified fourth row and is also vacuously true if no fourth row is required, matching the current validator. Every rationale must identify why the selected distinct claims belong together; fourth-row rationales need >=40 characters.

fullTranscriptCoverageAudit must cover every approved original event exactly once in consecutive intervals, including procedural material: {assessedWindowOnly:true,reviewOfExcludedRecording:false,intervals:[{startEvent,endEvent,moveIds,reason}]}. All moveIds must exist; procedural or repetition intervals may have an empty list and a reason. Never claim source review of excluded recording.
